purpose: Measure source scorer/recovery behavior on finite known-plaintext controls; no real manuscript key search.
timing: Source-derived counts and parameters were fixed in the batch wrappers before execution. This archival plan is compiled after that execution; it is not an independent prospective preregistration.
exclusions: Missing original EN_MODERN and Welsh corpora and derived vowel-deletion panels
A family-wide threshold for any large key search
Universal claims about natural language or encryption
numerics: Saved floating values rounded to ten decimal places after calculation; input indices and counts remain exact.
